title: Render mission epic/story tree in the Missions panel
description:
Edit src/api/DashboardSSE.mag to render, beneath each NON-ARCHIVED mission card, an indented tree of the mission's epic and its child stories (title/status/wave), built ENTIRELY from the already-cached tick snapshot. ZERO new bbs scanAll:/per-tick scans and ZERO new SSE channels.

Implementation:
- Add helper `renderMissionTree: m workitems: wis`: resolve epic by `wis detect: identity = (m payload at:'epic_id')` (epic has parent=nil, so it is NOT in the story filter); filter stories by `wis select: (payload at:'parent') = epic_id`; emit a nested <ul class="mission-tree"> with one <li class="mission-story"> per story showing htmlEscape:-d title, status, and wave. Guard: missing/empty epic_id, missing epic workitem, malformed rows -> render no tree, do not throw. Wrap in on: Exception.
- Add `sortStories: arr` mirroring sortMissions: (DashboardSSE.mag:618) but comparing `wave` NUMERICALLY (wave is an INTEGER via missionWaveOf:), tie-breaking on identity lexicographically; guard a non-integer/malformed wave so the comparator can't throw. Deterministic total order is REQUIRED so missionsHtml stays byte-stable tick-to-tick (sendElements:to:key: change-detection; else scroll reset / collapsed-plan churn).
- Wire renderMissionTree:workitems: in the AWAITING loop (~586-594) and the OTHERS loop (~595-603) ONLY; NEVER the archived loop (~606-613). Note both others+archived call renderMissionCard: awaiting:false, so gate by LOOP not by the awaiting flag. Thread the cached `workitems` array from renderMissionsHtml: (snap at:'workitems', DashboardSSE.mag:181) into the loops.
- Run EVERY user-controlled field (story title/status/wave, epic title/id) through htmlEscape: (handles asString + nil->''); no printString, no nil guard needed.
- Preserve existing per-mission/per-card on: Exception guards (MP2 must not regress). Never chain and: (nest compound predicates).
- static/dashboard.html is OUT OF SCOPE: no CSS. Tree renders as an unstyled nested list relying on default browser list indentation.

Tests (test/api/test_mission_panel.mag):
- Add a seedStory:/seedWorkitem: helper (none exists) that does bbs out: 'workitem' with payload type/parent/title/status/wave (mirror seedMissionWithEpic: at ~104).
- Add render test MP9: seed mission with epic_id + epic workitem + >=2 child stories on distinct waves; run sse computeSnapshot; read snap at:'missionsHtml'; assert (1) tree markup under the card, (2) each row has title+status+wave, (3) wave-then-identity ordering via substring-index checks, (4) a story titled <script>alert(1)</script> renders <script> with NO raw <script> surviving, (5) an ARCHIVED mission with epic_id emits NO tree markup. REGISTER MP9 in the runner invocation block at the bottom of the file (unregistered classes are silently skipped).

Conventions: update CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] in the same commit (explicitly sanctioned as the one allowed third-file touch); conventional-commit message.

Acceptance: all mission Success Criteria met; MP9 + existing test_mission_panel.mag suite pass; mag build green; no source file other than src/api/DashboardSSE.mag (+ its test + CHANGELOG.md) changed.
